segments.ja427:1.5: Tesaṃ ajagaramedaṃ, accahāsi bahuttaso [pahuttato (ka. sī.), pahūtaso (syā. pī.), bahudhaso (ka.)].
segments.ja427:2.1: Pitā ca puttaṃ avaca, jānaṃ uccaṃ papātinaṃ;
segments.ja427:2.3: Supattaṃ thāmasampannaṃ [pakkhasampannaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], tejassiṃ dūragāminaṃ.
segments.ja427:3.5: Tato tāta nivattassu, māssu etto paraṃ gami.
segments.ja427:4.1: Udapattosi [uddhaṃ pattosi (ka. sī.)] vegena, balī pakkhī dijuttamo;
segments.ja427:5.1: Addassa pathaviṃ gijjho, yathāsāsi [yathāssāsi (syā. aṭṭha. pāṭhantaraṃ)] pitussutaṃ;
segments.ja427:6.1: Tañca so samatikkamma, paramevaccavattatha [parameva pavattatha (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja427:6.3: Tañca vātasikhā tikkhā, accahāsi baliṃ dijaṃ.
segments.ja427:7.3: Dijo byasanamāpādi, verambhānaṃ [verambānaṃ (sī. pī.)] vasaṃ gato.
segments.ja427:8.1: Tassa puttā ca dārā ca, ye caññe anujīvino;
segments.ja427:9.1: Evampi idha vuḍḍhānaṃ, yo vākyaṃ nāvabujjhati;
segments.ja427:9.5: Sa ve byasanaṃ pappoti, akatvā vuḍḍhasāsananti.
